title: Senior Solution Architect (Product & Services)
description:
**Position Overview**

As a Senior Solution Architect, you will be a strategic leader, architecting and guiding the implementation of sophisticated technology solutions for both our innovative product development and critical client service engagements. Leveraging 12\-17 years of deep experience, you will bridge business objectives with technological execution, ensuring robust, scalable, secure, and strategically aligned solutions for our clients. This pivotal role demands a unique synthesis of profound technical expertise, sharp business acumen, and exceptional leadership to navigate the dual demands of product innovation and bespoke service delivery across diverse projects and technologies. You will define the technical vision and drive its successful realization. This role now also carries direct ownership of the solution lifecycle from pre\-sales through delivery, and is expected to build hands\-on alongside delivery teams — picking, customizing, and extending our AI\-native tooling (including our internal PDLC framework) rather than only advising on its use.

**Key Responsibilities**

Your responsibilities will span strategic design, product and service lifecycle management, technical leadership, stakeholder engagement, and governance.

**Strategic Solution Design \& Architecture**

* Translate complex business strategies, product requirements, and client needs into comprehensive architectural blueprints for both product offerings and customized service solutions. Lead architectural vision and strategy across internal product roadmaps and client projects, adapting fluidly to shifting contexts.
* Ensure all solutions are inherently scalable, resilient, secure by design, and strategically aligned with our clients' enterprise architecture and business goals. This alignment is critical for long\-term viability and maximizing technology investments.
* Evaluate, select, and champion appropriate technologies, platforms, architectural patterns (e.g., microservices, serverless, EDA), and design principles tailored to each product feature or service engagement, profoundly influencing evolutionary capacity and deployment efficiency.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce comprehensive architectural documentation (diagrams, standards, best practices) for clarity and consistency across product and service teams.

**Product \& Service Lifecycle Management**

* Collaborate with product management to define and refine product architecture, influence roadmaps with technical insights, and ensure technical feasibility and architectural soundness of new features. Early involvement is crucial for preempting costly missteps.
* Partner with service delivery and client engagement teams to design and customize solutions aligned with client expectations, contracts, and operations, requiring nuanced understanding of service design and adaptability.
* Oversee architectural integrity during implementation, providing decisive technical leadership and mentorship to development and delivery teams across product and service projects.
* Conduct rigorous architectural reviews and assessments, ensuring adherence to design principles, quality benchmarks, and non\-functional requirements across all projects.

**Pre\-Sales \& Hands\-On Delivery**

* Partner directly with the sales team during pre\-sales: scope solutions, build proof\-of\-concepts and demos, estimate effort, and present technical approach to prospective clients.
* Personally prototype and build critical\-path components alongside delivery teams — especially early in an engagement — to validate architecture decisions with working code, not diagrams alone.
* Own the technical narrative end\-to\-end, from opportunity through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization, ensuring nothing is lost in the handoff from sales to delivery.

**Technical Leadership \& Mentorship**

* Provide expert technical guidance, strategic advice, and dedicated mentorship to engineering teams and fellow architects, fostering continuous learning.
* Champion architectural best practices, advocate for emerging technologies, and drive a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
* Lead and oversee proof\-of\-concept (PoC) projects to evaluate new technologies and architectural approaches before wider adoption, de\-risking innovation.
* Evaluate, customize, and extend our internal AI\-assisted delivery tooling (e.g., our PDLC framework) rather than using it as\-is — and drive its adoption and evolution across delivery teams.

**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**

* Serve as the primary technical liaison and trusted advisor, bridging communication between business leaders, product management, engineering, service delivery, and clients.
* Clearly and persuasively articulate complex architectural concepts, strategic decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, negotiate priorities, and resolve conflicts regarding architectural direction and technology choices.

**Governance \& Continuous Improvement**  
\*

* Conduct thorough feasibility studies, risk assessments, and cost\-benefit analyses for proposed solutions and architectural changes.
* Continuously evaluate and recommend strategic improvements to architectures, processes, and technology stacks to enhance efficiency, performance, scalability, and reduce TCO.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry trends, emerging technologies, architectural paradigms, and best practices relevant to solution architecture, product development, and service delivery.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

**General Experience**

* Minimum 12\-17 years in IT, with 8\+ years in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or senior technical leadership, significantly influencing large\-scale technology outcomes.
* Proven track record of successfully designing and delivering complex, large\-scale technology solutions within both product development and client service delivery contexts.

**Technical Expertise**

* **Cloud Platforms:** Extensive hands\-on experience architecting and deploying solutions on major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, cloud\-native services, multi\-cloud/hybrid\-cloud strategies, cost optimization, and security best practices.
* **Modern Architectural Patterns:** Expertise in designing and implementing solutions using microservices, serverless, EDA, API\-driven design, and DDD.
* **DevOps \& Automation:** Strong understanding and experience with DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, IaC tools (e.g., Terraform), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **AI\-Native Engineering:** Hands\-on, daily use of agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf) to build production\-grade solutions at accelerated pace — not just autocomplete\-level usage. Practical experience with spec\-driven development (SDD) workflows and frameworks (e.g., OpenSpec, SpecKit, BMAD), agentic orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel) for multi\-agent systems, and RAG/vector\-database patterns. Comfort evaluating, selecting, and extending AI tooling for a team's specific delivery needs, with sound judgment on when AI\-generated output requires review or governance. Solid experience with data architecture principles (big data, data lakes, data warehousing, real\-time streaming) and integrating AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications.
* **Security Architecture:** In\-depth knowledge of security architecture principles, IAM solutions (e.g., SailPoint, Okta), threat modeling, data protection, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
* **Integration Technologies:** Proficiency in designing integration solutions using API\-first design (REST, GraphQL), API management platforms, message queuing (e.g., Kafka), and EIP.
* **Software Development Background:** Strong foundational understanding of software development principles and familiarity with common programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C\#) and frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET Core).
* **Enterprise Systems:** Experience with the architecture and integration of common enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, HRMS).

\*

**Methodologies**

* Deep understanding and practical experience applying Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and principles, with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience highly desirable.
* Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks such as ITIL is advantageous.
* Experience applying Agile and SAFe in a hybrid product development and client service delivery model.
* Experience adapting Agile/SAFe cadences for AI\-accelerated, spec\-first delivery cycles enabled by AI\-assisted build and review.

**Business Acumen**

* Strong ability to understand business strategies, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and client requirements, translating them into impactful technology solutions.
* Proven experience in conducting feasibility studies, risk assessments, and TCO/ROI analyses.
* Ability to think strategically and holistically, anticipate technology trends, and advise on long\-term architectural roadmaps.
* Direct experience owning or significantly contributing to pre\-sales estimation, solutioning, and proposal writing — not solely post\-signature delivery planning.

**Leadership \& Influence**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, coach, and inspire technical teams, fostering collaboration and innovation.
* Demonstrated experience influencing senior management and C\-level executives on strategic technology decisions.
* Capacity to drive organizational change and champion new architectural paradigms.
* Effective servant leadership style, providing vision and guardrails while empowering teams.

**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, articulating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including negotiation, conflict resolution, and consensus\-building.
* Proven stakeholder management capabilities, building trust and strong working relationships.

**Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Skills**

* Advanced analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities with a data\-driven approach.
* Proven capacity to analyze complex situations, identify root causes, and develop innovative solutions.
* Keen attention to detail in architectural design, documentation, and review.

**Preferred Qualifications**  
\*

* Relevant and current industry certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, SAFe for Architects, CISSP).
* Demonstrable experience within relevant industry verticals.
* Record of thought leadership (publications, presentations, open\-source contributions).

Pay: ₹3,000,000\.00 \- ₹4,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Site Engineer
description:
Job Description – Civil Site Engineer Position

**Civil Site Engineer**

Department

Projects / Construction

Location

On\-site

Employment Type

Full\-Time

Experience

**3–6 Years** (Residential, Commercial, or Infrastructure Projects)

Qualification

* B.E./B. Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering
* Valid certification in AutoCAD, Quantity Surveying, or Project Management is an added advantage.

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Civil Site Engineer to supervise day\-to\-day construction activities, ensure quality execution, monitor project progress, and coordinate with contractors, consultants, and vendors. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to deliver projects within timelines while maintaining quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities Site Execution

* Supervise and monitor all civil construction activities at the project site.
* Ensure work is executed according to approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP teams, and contractors for smooth execution.
* Verify layout, levels, dimensions, and alignment before execution.

Quality Control

* Ensure construction quality complies with project specifications and applicable standards.
* Conduct regular inspections and identify defects or deviations.
* Monitor material quality and workmanship.
* Prepare quality checklists and inspection reports.

Project Planning \& Monitoring

* Track daily work progress against project timelines.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Identify project risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Coordinate with project managers for resource planning.

Material Management

* Estimate material requirements based on project schedules.
* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
* Verify delivered materials against purchase orders and specifications.
* Coordinate with procurement for timely availability of materials.

Contractor Management

* Supervise contractors and subcontractors.
* Verify work completion for billing purposes.
* Ensure manpower productivity and adherence to project schedules.

Safety Compliance

* Ensure all construction activities follow company safety policies.
* Conduct toolbox talks and monitor PPE compliance.
* Report unsafe conditions and coordinate corrective actions.

Documentation

* Maintain site registers, measurement books, and work records.
* Prepare RA bills, BOQs, DPRs, and progress documentation.
* Maintain records of inspections, approvals, and project correspondence.

Client \& Consultant Coordination

* Attend site meetings with clients and consultants.
* Resolve technical queries during execution.
* Implement consultant instructions within project timelines.

Required Skills:\-  
Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of RCC, finishing, masonry, and structural works.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings.
* Knowledge of BOQ preparation and quantity estimation.
* Familiarity with IS Codes and construction standards.
* Understanding of QA/QC procedures and construction methodologies.

Software Skills

* AutoCAD
* MS Excel
* MS Project (Preferred)
* Primavera P6 (Preferred)
* ERP Software (Preferred)

Soft Skills

* Strong leadership abilities
* Excellent communication and coordination skills
* Time management
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Decision\-making capability
* Team collaboration
* Attention to detail

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of assigned project milestones.
* Quality compliance with minimal rework.
* Material wastage within approved limits.
* Adherence to project budget.
* Site safety compliance.
* Timely submission of reports and documentation.
* Contractor productivity and coordination efficiency.

Preferred Industry Experience

* Residential Township Projects
* High\-Rise Buildings
* Commercial Buildings
* Villas
* Industrial Projects
* Infrastructure Projects

Salary

Competitive and commensurate with qualifications, experience, and project exposure.

Reporting To

Project Manager / Construction Manager

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work on challenging construction projects.
* Professional growth in a dynamic work environment.
* Performance\-based career advancement.
* Collaborative and quality\-focused culture.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Architectural Draughtsman/woman
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Technical Drafting:** Develop comprehensive architectural plans, including floor layouts, elevations, site plans, and detailed construction blueprints using AutoCAD and Revit.
* **Design Translation:** Collaborate with lead architects and structural engineers to accurately translate conceptual sketches and specifications into functional construction documents.
* **Code Compliance:** Ensure all plans and technical documentation comply strictly with local building codes, zoning regulations, and international standards relevant to the project scope.
* **Site Integration:** Conduct field measurements and site surveys when required, incorporating site\-specific realities and constraints into the final drafting models.
* **Project Documentation:** Prepare and maintain accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQs), material specifications, and organized repositories of standard architectural symbols and templates.
* **Revisions \& Optimization:** Swiftly execute drawing revisions based on stakeholder feedback, ensuring strict version control and alignment with the overarching project timeline.

Qualifications \& Requirements

* **Educational Background:** Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology, or a closely related field.
* **Professional Experience:** 2 to 10\+ years of proven experience in architectural drafting, ideally with exposure to large\-scale real estate or commercial infrastructure projects.
* **Software Proficiency:** Mastery of AutoCAD; strong working knowledge of Revit, SketchUp, or other BIM and 3D modeling software is highly preferred.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Solid understanding of building materials, construction methods, and the integration of core structural and MEP systems.
* **Attributes:** Exceptional attention to detail, robust problem\-solving skills, and the ability to manage overlapping deadlines within a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹95,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description – E\-commerce Solution Architect**
====================================================

### **Role**

**E\-commerce Solution Architect / Technical Architect**### **Experience**

**12\+ years** of experience in software engineering, with strong experience in designing and architecting large\-scale e\-commerce applications.### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect** to define and drive the technical architecture of a large\-scale e\-commerce platform. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, QA, and business teams to design scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Java/Spring Boot, React, microservices, APIs, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, along with a solid understanding of modern e\-commerce architecture.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the **end\-to\-end architecture** for e\-commerce applications across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable and highly available solutions using **Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and React**.
* Define frontend architecture and best practices using **React, TypeScript, state management, and reusable components**.
* Design cloud\-native solutions on **GCP**, considering scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization.
* Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Define architecture standards, design patterns, coding standards, and technology guidelines.
* Review technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability or performance issues.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers, leads, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, infrastructure, observability, monitoring, and deployment strategies.
* Ensure solutions follow security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
* Support troubleshooting of complex production issues and provide long\-term architectural solutions.

### **Technical Skills**

**Backend*** Java 11/17\+
* Spring Boot / Spring Framework
* Microservices architecture
* REST APIs
* Event\-driven architecture
* Kafka or similar messaging platforms
* Distributed systems and caching

**Frontend*** React
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* React\-based application architecture
* State management
* Responsive and reusable UI architecture
* Frontend performance optimization

**Cloud – GCP*** Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform**
* GKE / Kubernetes
* Cloud Run
* Cloud Functions
* API Gateway / Apigee
* Pub/Sub
* Cloud SQL / Spanner
* Cloud Storage
* IAM and security
* Cloud Load Balancing
* Monitoring and Logging
* VPC and networking
* Cloud\-native architecture and cost optimization

**DevOps \& Engineering*** GitHub / Git
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* Automated testing
* Observability and application monitoring

### **E\-commerce Experience**


Strong experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:* Product catalog
* Search
* Pricing and promotions
* Cart and checkout
* Order management
* Payment integrations
* Inventory
* Customer/account management
* Personalization
* Store and e\-commerce integrations
* Third\-party integrations
* High\-volume transactional systems

### **Architecture \& Leadership**

* Strong understanding of **domain\-driven design (DDD)** and microservices.
* Experience designing **high\-volume, low\-latency distributed systems**.
* Strong understanding of API design and integration patterns.
* Experience with scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Ability to make architecture decisions considering **performance, maintainability, security, and cost**.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with senior engineering and business stakeholders and clearly communicate complex technical concepts.
* Experience mentoring technical leads and senior engineers.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with **5\+ years in an Architect/Senior Architect role**.
* Experience architecting **large\-scale e\-commerce platforms**.
* Strong combination of **Java \+ React \+ GCP** experience.
* GCP certification is a plus.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience working with distributed/global engineering teams.

### **What We Are Looking For**


The ideal candidate is not just an architecture/documentation person. We are looking for someone who can **work closely with engineering teams, challenge technical decisions, review implementation, troubleshoot complex problems, and drive the architecture from design through production**.**Core Technology Stack:****React \| TypeScript \| Java \| Spring Boot \| Microservices \| REST \| Kafka/Pub/Sub \| GCP \| Kubernetes \| Docker \| GitHub \| CI/CD**
